scripts.text:
[Yotang]
There lives a fairy on the 3rd floor of Kunlun.
She is so famous for her beauty
that she even got a fan club.
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
崑崙的三樓住著一位妖精。
她以美貌聞名，
甚至擁有自己的粉絲俱樂部。

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
Of course, I am the master of the fan club.
How about joining the fairy fan club?
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
當然，我就是這個粉絲俱樂部的主席。
要不要加入妖精粉絲俱樂部呢？

scripts.text: I'm not that interested!!
scripts.translation: 我一點興趣都沒有！！

scripts.text: I'll join it right away!!
scripts.translation: 我馬上加入！！

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
What! I'm going to tell on you!
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
什麼！我要去告發你！

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
Oh, aren't those....!
the materials for the Flower of Fairy?
Have we met before? You already know everything...
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
哦，那不是....！
製作妖精之花的材料嗎？
我們以前見過？你什麼都知道...

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
Anyway, do you want me to make the Flower of Fairy?
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
總之，你想讓我製作妖精之花嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
^FF0000Please be aware that
the refinement on the materials will all disappear
if you once combine those.^000000
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
^FF0000請注意，
一旦合成，材料上的精煉屬性將會全部消失。^000000

scripts.text: No, next time.
scripts.translation: 不，下次再說。

scripts.text: Make it right now!!
scripts.translation: 現在就做！！

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
You'll regret it!
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
你會後悔的！

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
You're speedy!
You deserve to be a master of the fanclub for the next term.
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
動作真快！
你完全有資格擔任下一屆粉絲俱樂部的主席。

scripts.text: Combining... ... ...

[Yotang]
Here, the Flower of Fairy.
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
給你，妖精之花。

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
See you on the fan meeting!
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
粉絲見面會上見！

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
Huh? You don't have enough
materials for it..
Aren't you wearing Bandana?
Check it out!
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
咦？你的材料不夠啊..
難道你沒戴方頭巾？
檢查一下！

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
Bring me all the materials,
if you want to get the Flower of Fairy.
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
如果你想獲得妖精之花，
就把所有材料都帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
If you bring me ^0000FF100 Transparent Celestial Robes, 100 Soft Silk Cloth,
1 Wedding Bouquet, 1 Violet Dyestuffs
and ^0000FF1 Bandana^000000 which you can find at a store,
I will make you a ^0000FFFlower of Fairy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
如果你給我^0000FF100件害羞之服、100件柔軟的綢緞布、
1束捧花、1份紫色染料
以及^0000FF1件方頭巾^000000（可以在商店買到），
我就為你製作一朵^0000FF妖精之花^000000。

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
You can meet the fairy soon
for there will be a fan meeting
in the near future.
The Flower of Fairy is necessary
for joining the fan meeting. Everyone wears it.
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
很快就能見到妖精了，
因為近期將舉行粉絲見面會。
參加粉絲見面會需要妖精之花。大家都戴著它。

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
If you bring me some materials
I'll make it for you.
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
如果你給我一些材料，
我就為你製作。

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
I need ^0000FF100 Transparent Celestial Robes, 100 Soft Silk Cloth,
1 Wedding Bouquet, 1 Violet Dyestuffs
and ^0000FF1 Bandana^000000 which you can find at a store,
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
我需要^0000FF100件害羞之服、100件柔軟的綢緞布、
1束捧花、1份紫色染料
以及^0000FF1件方頭巾^000000（可以在商店買到），

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
If you bring me ^0000FF100 Transparent Celestial Robes, 100 Soft Silk Cloth,
1 Wedding Bouquet, 1 Violet Dyestuffs
and ^0000FF1 Bandana^000000 which you can find at a store,
I will make you a ^0000FFFlower of Fairy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
如果你給我^0000FF100件害羞之服、100件柔軟的綢緞布、
1束捧花、1份紫色染料
以及^0000FF1件方頭巾^000000（可以在商店買到），
我就為你製作一朵^0000FF妖精之花^000000。

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
^FF0000Please be aware that
the refinement on the materials will all disappear
if you once combine those.^000000
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
^FF0000請注意，
一旦合成，材料上的精煉屬性將會全部消失。^000000

scripts.text: I won't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不做了。

scripts.text: Here, I have the materials!
scripts.translation: 這裡，我有材料！

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
You'll regret it!
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
你會後悔的！

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
Huh? Are you kidding me?
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
咦？你在開玩笑嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
I need ^0000FF100 Transparent Celestial Robes, 100 Soft Silk Cloth,
1 Wedding Bouquet, 1 Violet Dyestuffs
and ^0000FF1 Bandana^000000 which you can find at a store
to make a ^0000FFFlower of Fairy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
我需要^0000FF100件害羞之服、100件柔軟的綢緞布、
1束捧花、1份紫色染料
以及^0000FF1件方頭巾^000000（可以在商店買到），
才能製作一朵^0000FF妖精之花^000000。

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
Your bag is too heavy, isn't it?
Come to me again
after emptying your bag.
scripts.translation:
[約唐]
你的背包太重了吧？
清空背包後再來找我。

scripts.text:
- Wait !! -
- You have too many items, so it's -
- impossible to have more. -
- Come to me again -
- after emptying some of it. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 你的物品太多了，所以 -
- 不可能再裝更多了。 -
- 清空一些物品後 -
- 再來找我。 -

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Hey... you wanna fight?!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
嘿...你想打架嗎？！

scripts.text: He seems to be drunken badly. What should I do?
scripts.translation: 他好像醉得很厲害。我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text: Just ignore him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text: Fight!
scripts.translation: 戰鬥！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Why are you ignoring me?
Are you afraid of me?
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
你為什麼無視我？
你怕我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
What... you're weaker than me.
Go and reach the higher level!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
什...麼...你比我弱。
去提升等級吧！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Hold! I need some armor to wear.
That's it, Necktie, Necktie...
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
等等！我需要穿件盔甲。
對了，領帶，領帶...

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Once I wear the Necktie on my head,
I will be no match for you!
You must be nervous.
Hmm! Where is the Necktie?
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
一旦我把領帶戴在頭上，
你就不是我的對手了！
你一定很緊張吧。
嗯！領帶在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Oh, you're having the materials for Necktie! give them to me!!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
哦，你身上有領帶的材料！快給我！！

scripts.text: No way!
scripts.translation: 絕對不行！

scripts.text: Here you are.
scripts.translation: 給你。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Ohh, you are scared!
I won again!!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
哦，你嚇壞了！
我又贏了！！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Great, wait for a moment!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
很好，等一下！

scripts.text: Combining... ch...ch... ...

[Drunken Man]
Drunk...drunk.... Zzzzz...

He zonked out as soon as
he finished it.
Let's just take the Necktie.
scripts.translation:
他剛做完就睡著了。
把領帶拿走吧。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Huh? Where are all the materials gone?
Did you take it back that you're so afraid of me?
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
咦？材料都不見了？
難道你怕我，把它們拿走了？

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Hey, go and get
^FF00001 Cobaltblue Dyestuff, 30 Oil Papers, 100 Fabrics, 20 Spools^000000!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
去給我弄來
^FF00001個鈷藍染料、30張油紙、100塊布料、20個線軸^000000！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
I will beat you off wearing the legendary Necktie!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
我要戴著那條傳說中的領帶，把你揍飛！

scripts.text: I won't.
scripts.translation: 我不寫

scripts.text: Let's go and get them.
scripts.translation: 去收集材料

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Are you dropping out?
Did I win again?
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
你要放棄嗎？
我又贏了吧？

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
I'm telling you once more
for you might forget it, dumbhead!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
我再告訴你一次，
免得你這笨蛋忘了！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
^FF00001 Cobaltblue Dyestuff, 30 Oil Papers, 100 Fabrics, 20 Spools^000000!
Hurry! I'll be futzing around with others.
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
^FF00001個鈷藍染料、30張油紙、100塊布料、20個線軸^000000！
快點！我還要陪別人玩呢。

scripts.text:
Necktie is heavier than I thought.
Seems like the very legendary Necktie.
scripts.translation:
這條領帶比我想像中要重。
看來是傳說中的領帶。

scripts.text:
- Wait !! -
- You have too many items, so it's -
- impossible to have more. -
- Come to me again -
- after emptying some of it. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 你的物品太多了，所以 -
- 不可能再裝更多了。 -
- 清空一些物品後 -
- 再來找我。 -

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
Isn't the unique hat much better
than the common hairbands?
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
獨特的帽子不是比普通的髮帶更好看嗎？

scripts.text: I still prefer hairbands!
scripts.translation: 我還是喜歡髮帶！

scripts.text: Hat is the best!
scripts.translation: 帽子才是最好的！

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
Wear your boring hairband for the whole lifetime!
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
那你就戴著那無聊的髮帶過一輩子吧！

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
You have a good sense!
I thought I would make
a trendy hat.
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
你的眼光真不錯！
我想做一頂時尚的帽子。

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
I will give you an honor,
to be a fashion superstar,
if you bring me the materials for it.
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
如果你能給我材料，
我就給你個榮譽，
讓你成為時尚巨星。

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
Oh! you're bringing ^0000FFthe materials for Hair Brush^000000.
Do you want me to make it now?
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
哦！你帶來了^0000FF製作紅髮梳的材料^000000。
你想讓我現在做嗎？

scripts.text: I think the hairband is better...
scripts.translation: 我覺得髮帶更好...

scripts.text: Yes, please make it!
scripts.translation: 是的，請做吧！

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
Wear your boring hairband for the whole lifetime!
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
那你就戴著那無聊的髮帶過一輩子吧！

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
Okay, I'll do it right away!
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
好的，我馬上做！

scripts.text: Ch ch ch... combining...ch ch.

[Hat Girl]
Here, it's done!
Now you're the fashionista!
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
好了，完成了！
現在你就是時尚達人啦！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I got the Hair Brush.
...but it makes me sad.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我拿到了(時裝)紅髮梳。
...但這讓我感到難過。

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
Huh? Don't you want to be
the best fashionista?
You don't have enough materials?
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
咦？你不想成為最棒的時尚達人嗎？
材料不夠嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
To make the latest style ^0000FFHair Brush^000000,
I need ^0000FF1 Mixture, 1 Scarlet Dyestuffs,
50 Solid Shells, 5 Eluniums,^000000
also 1 ^0000FFAxe^000000 with 4 sockets on it.
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
要製作最新款的^0000FF(時裝)紅髮梳^000000，
我需要^0000FF1個混合劑、1個紅色染料、
50個堅硬外皮、5個鋁，^000000
還需要1把帶有4個孔的^0000FF斧頭^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
What are you doing? Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
你在幹什麼？快點！

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
Here is one tip for you.
You can easily get Solid Shells and Elunium from the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
給你一個小提示。
你可以很容易地從魔物身上獲得堅硬外皮和鋁。

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
You're carrying too much stuff.
Come again after emptying your bag.
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
你攜帶的物品太多了。
清空背包後再來吧。

scripts.text:
- Wait !! -
- You have too many items, so it's -
- impossible to have more. -
- Come to me again -
- after emptying some of it. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 你的物品太多了，所以 -
- 不可能再裝更多了。 -
- 清空一些物品後 -
- 再來找我。 -

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
A fake angel? Go away!
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
假天使？走開！

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
The real angel
is not as weak as you.
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
真正的神天使
不像你這麼弱。

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Oh, the angel came again.
Are you quite satisfied with ^FF0000Statue Of Baby Angel^000000, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
哦，天使又來了。
你對^FF0000小天使雕像^000000還滿意吧？

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Ah! Hey, angel~ angel~
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
啊！嘿，天使~天使~

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Please show me the Statue of Baby Angel!
I heard every angel has it!
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
請給我看看小天使雕像！
我聽說每個天使都有！

scripts.text: Statue of Baby Angel?
scripts.translation: 小天使雕像？

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Did you lose it?
Do you want me to make it for you?
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
你弄丟了？
你想讓我給你做一個嗎？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text: Yes, I want it now.
scripts.translation: 是的，我現在就要。

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Oh... it's not easy to make a living!
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
唉...生活真不容易啊！

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Wow, you already know all the materials, angel.
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
哇，天使，你已經知道所有材料了。

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
You're lucky. I have one statue on going.
So you don't need to wait for long.
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
你很幸運。我正好有一個雕像在做。
所以你不用等太久。

scripts.text: I got the ^FF0000Statue of Baby Angel^000000.
scripts.translation: 我拿到了^FF0000小天使雕像^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
See you again, my angel~!
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
再見了，我的天使~！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm... I guess I was fooled by that little kid.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...看來我被那個小孩子騙了。

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Hey, I don't see
any materials in your bag..
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
嘿，我好像沒看到
你背包裡有材料...

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Hey, angel...
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
嘿，天使...

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Wow, the angel!
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
哇，是天使！

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Are you a real angel? Have you been to heaven?
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
你是真正的天使嗎？你去過天堂嗎？

scripts.text: What bullshit!
scripts.translation: 胡說八道！

scripts.text: Let's keep the childhood innocence!
scripts.translation: 讓我們保持童心吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Angel and heaven? It's all made up!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天使和天堂？那都是編出來的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There's nothing. Everything is lie!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼都沒有。一切都是謊言！

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
You're a devil! a monster! an idiot!
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
你是惡魔！是魔物！是個笨蛋！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course. I used to dance with the dragon and zebra
on the vanilla-taste clouds.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然。我曾經和龍還有斑馬
在香草味的雲朵上跳舞。

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
That's just what I've been imagining!
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
那只是我想像出來的！

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Please show me the Statue of Baby Angel!
I heard every angel has it!
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
請給我看看小天使雕像！
我聽說每個天使都有！

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Oops, did you lose it?
Do you want me to make one for you?
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
哎呀，你弄丟了？
你想讓我給你做一個嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
I made it several times before
for the angels like you.
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
我之前已經給像你這樣的天使
做過好幾次了。

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
I can make it with ^FF0000500 Feather Of Birds, 1 Holy Water, 10 Muscovite, 1 Heaven Ring and 1 Shining Stone^000000.
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
我可以用^FF0000500個鳥羽、1個聖水、10個雲母、1個天堂戒指和1個閃爍之石^000000來做。

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Okay, hurry!
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
好的，快點！

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
A fake angel? Go away!!
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
假天使？走開！！

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
The real angel has
the wings on the head!
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
真正的天使
翅膀是在頭上的！

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
What are you carrying that much, angel?
I can't give you the item
because your bag is too full.
scripts.translation:
[貝貝特]
天使，你帶了這麼多東西？
因為你的背包太滿了，
所以我無法把物品給你。

scripts.text:
- Wait !! -
- You have too many items, so it's -
- impossible to have more. -
- Come to me again -
- after emptying some of it. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 你的物品太多了，所以 -
- 不可能再裝更多了。 -
- 清空一些物品後 -
- 再來找我。 -

scripts.text:
[???]
Hmm..Hm..
It seems my transformation into the child's appearance is successful.
scripts.translation:
[???]
嗯...嗯...
看來我變成小孩子外表的偽裝很成功。

scripts.text:
[???]
Human! I am here to ask you some help.
scripts.translation:
[???]
人類！我來這裡是想請你幫個忙。

scripts.text:
[???]
I am the great King Froggie VII!
scripts.translation:
[???]
我是偉大的青蛙王七世！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
but I think you're not strong enough to help us.
Go and train more!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
但我覺得你還不夠強，幫不了我們。
去多訓練一下吧！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Over lvl 65 human will be fine for us.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
65級以上的人類對我們來說就足夠了。

scripts.text:
[???]
I am the great king, Froggie VII..
I need your help!
scripts.translation:
[???]
我是偉大的國王，青蛙七世。
我需要你的幫助！

scripts.text: Just ignore it.
scripts.translation: 直接無視

scripts.text: Let's help him.
scripts.translation: 幫他一把

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Talking frog...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
會說話的青蛙...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now I've seen everything.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真是見多識廣了。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Croaking...Croaking...
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
呱呱...呱呱...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Our great frog race is now endangered because many travellers came here and take our eggs as a kind of souvenirs. I even heard there are many left on the ground here and there, so I need your help. Please bring back ^FF0000100 Spawn^000000.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我們偉大的青蛙一族現在正處於危險之中，因為許多旅行者來到這裡，把我們的蛋當作紀念品帶走。我甚至聽說地上到處都散落著蛋，所以我需要你的幫助。請帶回^FF0000100個蛙卵^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒問題，我會的。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我會等著你的！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
What are you doing here?
Go and get ^FF0000100 Spawn^000000!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
你在這裡做什麼？
快去收集^FF0000100個蛙卵^000000！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Oh, you brought all of them!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
哦，你都帶回來了！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Thank you so much, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
非常感謝你，{0}。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
By the way, we have another urgent matter. So I would ask you one more help.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
順便說一下，我們還有另一件緊急的事情。所以我想再請你幫個忙。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Frogs are healthy food to the snakes.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
對蛇來說，青蛙是健康的食物。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I know well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我當然知道。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Well, that's good. Aren't you feel sorry for our race?
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
很好。難道你不覺得我們的種族很可憐嗎？

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
So, I hereby ask you to take revenge on them. Kill ^FF000050 Side Winders^000000 for us.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
所以，我在此請求你替我們復仇。為我們擊殺^FF000050只黑蛇^000000。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
I'll be waiting for your news!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我會等待你的好訊息！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
I'm waiting for your good news.
It would be a piece of cake for you
to kill ^FF000050 Side Winders^000000. Keep it up!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我在等待你的好訊息。
擊殺^FF000050只黑蛇^000000對你來說是小菜一碟。加油！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我回來了。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
You seemingly killed all the Side Winders!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
看來你已經殺光了所有的黑蛇！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
You became an example for the young frogs. Thank you again.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
你成為了年輕青蛙們的榜樣。再次感謝你。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Therefore, I'm considering adding your outstanding exploit to our frog's history book. But I need your evidence for your work.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
因此，我考慮將你的卓越功績載入青蛙史書。但我需要你的工作證據。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Please bring me ^FF0000 100 ^000000 ^FF0000Venom Canines^000000 from the snakes.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
請從蛇那裡帶回^FF0000100個^000000^FF0000毒牙^000000給我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm happy to be added in the history book. I'll go and get them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很高興能載入史書。我會去收集它們的。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Obedient, hard-working... I hope I have a loyal frog like you.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
聽話、勤勞...我希望我也能擁有像你這樣忠誠的青蛙。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
How about ^FF0000100 Venom Canines^000000?
Hurry, it's a rare opportunity to be added in the frog history book!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
^FF0000100個毒牙^000000怎麼樣？
快點，這是載入青蛙史書的難得機會！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Oh, you brought Venom Canines! Now, I'm able to put you in the frog history book officially.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
哦，你帶回了毒牙！現在，我可以正式將你載入青蛙史書了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's good for me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這對我來說是好事。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
I have a better news!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我有個更好的訊息！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
I found a great method to keep our race while I was looking up the history book!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我在查閱史書時，發現了一個保護我們種族的好方法！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
The answer was in the frog history book. In the old days, the great King Froggie III made a secret medicine enabling us to use a hiding skill from the snakes.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
答案就在青蛙史書中。在古代，偉大的青蛙王三世發明了一種秘藥，讓我們能夠使用隱匿技能來躲避蛇。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
I should have known this earlier...
Please get me ^FF000050 Scaled Shells^000000.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我本該早點知道這一點的...
請幫我收集^FF000050個鱗片^000000。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
It's not easy to get, but I'm sure you can do it.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
這並不容易，但我相信你能做到。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Still here? Go and get ^FF000050 Scaled Shells^000000! Please hurry!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
還在這裡？快去收集^FF000050個鱗片^000000！請快點！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Excellent!
You're like the great King Froggie III in his young days!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]

你就像年輕時的青蛙王三世一樣！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
You are already the hero for our frogs! If I have a child, I would marry you up with my child.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
你已經是青蛙們的英雄了！如果我有個孩子，我會把你許配給我的孩子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah... No, thanks.
^FF0000(Are you telling me to marry a frog???)^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...不，謝謝。
^FF0000(你是在讓我嫁給一隻青蛙嗎？？？)^000000

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Thanks to you, the population of frog has increased but we're short of food.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
The best food for us is ^FF0000Argiope^000000.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
對我們來說，最好的食物是^FF0000艾吉歐蜈蚣^000000。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Now, what are you doing, our hero?
Go and get ^FF000050 Argiopes^000000!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
I think I saw you a while ago, but now you became the hero for the frogs...
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
It was really lucky for me to ask you a favor.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]

scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]

scripts.text:
- Wait !! -
- You have too many items, so it's -
- impossible to have more. -
- Come to me again -
- after emptying some of it. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 你的物品太多了，所以 -
- 不可能再裝更多了。 -
- 清空一些物品後 -
- 再來找我。 -

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]

to give our hero, {0}
a Frog Hat which is one of our precious treasures?

送給我們的英雄{0}？

scripts.text:

croooooaaaaak~~~
Croak croak
scripts.translation:

呱...呱...
呱~~~~~~
呱呱

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Hmm, there is no objection.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
I hereby give {0}, our hero, this Frog Hat.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我在此將青蛙帽授予我們的英雄{0}。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]

Visit here at any time.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
All the frogs in the world, praise {0}, our eternal hero!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]

scripts.text: There is a frog. What should I do?
scripts.translation: 有一隻青蛙。我該怎麼做？

scripts.text: Throw it a stone.

scripts.text: Have a conversation.

scripts.text: Ouch~

[{0}]
It's so amazing to see
the frog which transforms itself.

[{0}]

scripts.text:
[{0}]

[{0}]

I am an expert at playing alone.

Huhu, Yapyap!

呼呼，呀呀！

scripts.text:

[阿洛妮]

The special training, to play alone in Sphinx Dungeon!
For make it
the fruitful training,
Get around and kill

My affection-lacked student!
This is the end of your training!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛妮]
終於做到了。
我缺乏愛意的學生！
你的訓練到此結束！

scripts.text:
[Alonie]
Playing outside with this heavy bag?
You are the real
expert to play alone!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛妮]
揹著這麼重的包在外面玩？
你真是獨自玩耍的專家！

scripts.text:
[Alonie]
If you want the reward, empty your bag, first!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛妮]
如果你想要獎勵，先清空你的背包！

scripts.text:
[Alonie]
Here! The solo play box
the most effective at {0}!
After putting on this box,
you're the best lonely being!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛妮]
給你！對{0}最有效的獨自玩耍盒子！
戴上這個盒子後，
你就是最棒的孤獨者！

scripts.text:
[Alonie]
Fight back your tears!
Huhu, Yapyap!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛妮]
忍住你的眼淚！
呼呼，呀呀！

scripts.text:
[Alonie]
Hmmm, It's not enough.
Playing alone is not that easy thing!
Go and kill
^FF000020 The Papers and 40 Firelock Soldiers^000000!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛妮]
嗯，還不夠。
獨自玩耍沒那麼容易！
去擊殺
^FF000020只紙妖和40只武士火槍兵^000000！

scripts.text:
[Alonie]
I am the playing-alone expert.
Always trying my best to play alone!

我是獨自玩耍的專家。
總是盡力獨自玩耍！
